title: Products of injective objects are injective
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with a product $\prod_{b\in B} I_b$ for a set-indexed family of objects. If every $I_b$ is injective, then the product $\prod_{b\in B} I_b$ is injective.
